name: dawn-civic
nameRationale: dawn = warm Parisian morning light (Jan Jansen hero source); civic = ordered Apple/Haussmann architectural precision (pale-current source). The two words together describe a daylit institutional clarity — public, precise, warm.

color-system.twistDescription: Verbatim copy — no modification. pageBackground #fbfbfd (luminance: bright/light).

type-system.twistDescription: Added +0.05em letterSpacing to h1, p, link, and nav element rules — measured tracking that increases spatial pressure without altering font families. Fonts: DM Sans (replaces proprietary grotesque), Josefin Sans (retained), Nunito (replaces avenir variants). All via Google Fonts CDN. proprietaryFonts: [].

motion-system.twistDescription: All instances of the CSS keyword 'ease' replaced with cubic-bezier(0.4, 0.0, 0.2, 1) — Material standard deceleration easing. Retained: ease-in-out (bidirectional states), duration tokens 1s/0.5s/0.15s.

grid-system.twistDescription: Flex gap increased from 40px to 48px (+20%); responsive breakpoint row/column gaps increased from 45px to 53px (+18%). Consistent proportional expansion maintaining the original rhythm at a more generous scale.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Section marginTop/marginBottom increased from 126px to 158px (+32px); footer marginTop increased from 86px to 118px (+32px); div-6 marginTop increased from 86px to 118px. Uniform +32px expansion creating more generous vertical breathing room.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Added translateY(-2px) to all button hover states (default-button-1 and default-button-4). Buttons physically lift on hover — a micro-interaction that implies tactile responsiveness without changing color or size tokens.

nav-system.twistDescription: paddingInline increased from 22px to 48px — more than doubles the lateral breathing room of the nav. fontFamily updated from Inter to DM Sans (Check C consistency fix: nav must reference an assembled type system font family).

concept-summary.twistDescription: Typography paragraph shifted from craft-narrative register to tactile/material register — letterforms described as physical objects (die stamps, compression, material pressure). concept_by_video.md freshly generated with 3 video placements: hero-civic-morning.mp4 (Haussmann stone at dawn), atelier-light.mp4 (workshop time-lapse), collection-in-motion.mp4 (product examination).

consistencyChecks.checkA_colorContrast: PASS — pageBackground #fbfbfd (brightness ~251) vs bodyText #1d1d1f (brightness ~29). High contrast pair.
consistencyChecks.checkB_motionInteraction: PASS — hover transitions 0.25s–0.45s; motion system durations 0.15s–1s. Max ratio ~3× (hover 0.45s vs motion 0.15s short). Within 5× threshold.
consistencyChecks.checkC_navFont: FIXED — nav source had 'Inter' (not in assembled type system DM Sans/Josefin Sans/Nunito). Updated nav.typography.fontFamily and nav.logo.fontFamily to 'DM Sans'.
